$comment: Dataset classes of the contacts domain: CRM contacts (one key, names in kanji/kana/romaji, a birth date, several phones and addresses) on their way to entity resolution.
description: CRM contacts read through a column map, and the same contacts standardized for matching.

contacts.description: One contact per key as the exports gave it, mapped to the standard field names, with its phones and addresses attached.

key.description: The contact's key (CONT_ID, or key columns joined with |).

contact_records.description: Contacts standardized for matching: name keys in both scripts, company name core, phones canonical, addresses parsed to town, house and unit.

full_n.description: Name in kana, small kana and long vowels folded.

core_k.description: A company's name without legal form or branch.
